sum: Azora Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that develops small molecule new chemical entities for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. It offers treatment for dermatology and gastroenterology. The company's pipeline includes AT177, a colon-targeted aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) agonist to enable localized activation with limited systemic exposure in development for ulcerative colitis. Azora Therapeutics, Inc. was formerly known as Meya Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and changed its name to Azora Therapeutics, Inc. in March 2019. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Encino, California.
